PockPock Agent 0.2.12 fixes problems found through **Report a problem**. Status marks now match what actually happened. A finished task offers its result: **Open demo** for a web page it made, and **Open task folder**.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

**Already using 0.2.11 on Windows?** PockPock updates itself: press **Restart to update** when it appears, or check in **Settings → Updates**. Your chats, settings, models and caches are kept. On a Mac, download and install it once, the same way as the first time.

**New to PockPock?** Open the downloaded file, then press **Set up PockPock**; setup installs everything else. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki/Installation).

## What's new since 0.2.11

### See the result

- When a PockPock Agent task finishes and its checks pass, the reply ends with **Done, and the checks passed**. It offers **Open demo**, which opens the web page the task made in your browser, and **Open task folder**.

### Status you can trust

- A step is marked green only when it really finished. When a step's check fails, the step and its retries are shown in red. Before, they could turn green anyway.
- The plan's checks are plain bullets until they run. With **Plan in steps**, each one turns green or red when its step is checked.
- **Retry from step** now starts at the first step that did not pass.
- An OpenClaw task that finished while some actions failed or were blocked now says so under the reply. The task list shows **Done with problems** instead of **Done**.

### Fixes from problem reports

- **Websites with Plan in steps.** A small model sometimes wrote a page as text instead of saving it, so the step failed three times with "file does not exist: index.html". PockPock now saves that text as the file the step needs. If the step is retried, the model is told exactly how to save it.
- **CSS and JavaScript files.** The task folder now accepts CSS, JavaScript, SVG, Python and other text files. Before, a website made without an open folder could not save `styles.css` or `script.js`.
- **Files attached earlier in a chat.** A follow-up such as "make the resume look nice" now uses the documents attached earlier in the same chat, and they are shown on the new message. If no file is attached at all, the agent asks you to attach it instead of trying again and again.
- **OpenClaw after Stop.** Stopping OpenClaw, changing the model and sending a new message could fail with "Terminal accounting session changed". That message came from the stopped task and no longer affects the new one.

### One engine switch

- The engine is chosen with the switch at the top of the task (Chat, PockPock Agent, OpenClaw, NemoClaw). The duplicate picker in the message box was removed.

## Good to know

- The pull request passed the full check suite (backend tests and desktop typecheck and build on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS). The new screens were checked in the app with sample tasks.
- Not tested yet with a real model: a Plan in steps run where the model writes a file as text.
- If you reported these problems, you can mark the reports as fixed on the **Maintenance** page after updating.
- Help is in the [wiki](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki). Please [report problems](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/issues/new/choose).
